assessment: Preserve all replay outcomes; additionally report only full-context alarm-eligible recordings. ITU has no eligible continuous negatives, so do not infer a valid continuous-stream FPR from it.

small_task.change: Match both classes at original one-second publisher segment duration. Do not stretch/loop clips or bridge unknown gaps.
small_task.features: Same256 uniform-Hz log spectral input, retain only47 STFT frames wholly within real1s at16kHz; temporal frequency mean/std512 descriptors. No padded frames contribute.
small_task.guard: Use data integrity and label/interval metadata only to revise compatibility before scoring; model/threshold panel unchanged.
small_task.labels: Published manual positive intervals and publisher background designation; individual disagreements unavailable and background labels not a verified acoustic absence benchmark.
small_task.selection: Fixed0.5 score threshold, no validation-driven changes; evaluate segment and interval aggregation. Retain all splits, labels and predictions.
small_task.splits: Publisher interval-disjoint assignments; check exact raw sample-half overlap across splits before fitting. All windows from a given published positive interval remain together. Same-session feasibility, not new-session reliability.
small_task.training: Train-only weighted StandardScaler; L2 logistic C1, max_iter2000, seed42, one initialization on mean bag descriptors plus four max-positive-instance updates retaining negative clips; equal interval mass and class mass.
